notes: The recursive self-qualification and parenthetical sincerity-checking are recognizably DFW-adjacent, but the voice lacks his footnote architecture, his specific brand of intellectual anxiety, and his tendency to spiral into genuine philosophical digression rather than merely emotional elaboration — and the result, while distinctive, reads more like a competent impression than an uncanny one, and would almost certainly strike a professional recipient as overwrought to the point of unsendable.
